name: The Chamba invade Kwararafa

summary.text: Late in the 18th century Chamba warbands from the uplands of today's Adamawa pushed west down the Benue, themselves driven by Fulani raids. They invaded the Kwararafa heartland and drove the last king of the old confederacy, Adi Matswen, into exile. The Jukun who regrouped at Wukari after him ruled a smaller kingdom of Jukun alone.

routes.label: West down the Benue into the Jukun heartland
routes.note: Drawn from the Chamba homeland around Ganye to Wukari; the bands' real paths are not recorded.

moments.title: The last Aku of Kwararafa in exile
moments.text: The Chamba invasion forces Adi Matswen from his capital.

reviewNotes: The Chamba of Donga and Takum, who settled among the Jukun, may date from this movement; not yet checked.
